name: buggy
displayName: buggy — the bug crawls to the root cause
description: A pixel bug in the status bar that twitches when your suite is red; a command that locates the root cause by evidence and a generated law; the bug crawls your executed lines in the editor and stops where the law ruled. No model.

buggy.path.description: The buggy executable (a venv's bin/buggy works).

buggy.python.description: The interpreter that runs the target's suite (default: the project's own .venv, else the one buggy runs under).

buggy.bisect.description: Also bisect the commit that introduced it (slower).

buggy.onSave.description: Locate again when a .py file is saved.
